_comment: Phase Analysis Configuration File - Edit these settings to control data processing

normalization._comment_normalization: enabled: Turn normalization on/off for all files, apply_to_both_types: Apply to both INCA and AZTEC (if false, only INCA)

images._comment_images: embed_images: Extract and embed SEM images from AZTEC files, min_width_columns: Minimum display width (≈240px), max_width_columns: Maximum display width (≈480px), preserve_aspect_ratio: Keep original image proportions
